items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: And I've known him for years, and we've been friends and admirers of each other.

ctx.x: Yeah. And I've known him for years, and we've been friends and admirers of each other. I still admire Jonah, but I don't remember seeing Jonah --
Well isn't this -- isn't this normal, Herman, that musicians, if they're working, don't have a chance to see another musician working.
